summary: Frontend-only testing of the Willingness-to-Pay Survey feature on /h/af70d32a45 and /admin. All 4 flows passed end-to-end in a real persistent browser: (1) Survey renders below carousel & share buttons on shared story, question text matches exactly '¿Pagarías $9.900 al año por esta app?', clicking Sí shows survey-thanks card, sets localStorage cp_survey_answered='1', fires POST /api/survey -> HTTP 200, and auto-hides after ~2.8s. (2) Once-per-device: after answering, reload hides the card; clearing cp_survey_answered re-shows it. (3) 'Ahora no' hides the card without setting localStorage and without firing any POST. (4) Admin login with Cuentapatas.2026 shows admin-survey-card with the exact question incl. $9.900, yes=1, no=1, pct=50%, and progress bar width style set to 50% matching yes_pct. The main agent's concern about clicks not POSTing was a screenshot-tool limitation — real browser confirms POST occurs and admin counts increment.
critical_code_review_comments: SurveyCard.answer() sets localStorage BEFORE awaiting submitSurvey; if the POST silently fails (catch swallows error), the user's response is lost on backend yet the flag is set, so they will never retry. Consider only setting the flag on 200 OK (or when backend responds already=true).
SurveyCard swallows errors with empty catch — no toast/log, so backend failures are invisible to QA and users.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 1 Sí and 1 No answer to /api/survey using two distinct cp_device_id values during testing. These persist in MongoDB survey collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Survey feature is fully working. During test, admin survey counts are now at least yes=1, no=1 (may be higher if other tests added more). The localStorage keys involved: cp_survey_answered (gate), cp_device_id (device dedupe on backend). To re-trigger survey in UI testing, remove cp_survey_answered and optionally set a new cp_device_id to bypass backend dedupe.
